title: interrupted_step_resume_input/v1
description: The step input that the host writes to .baltor/resume/input.json before launch. The host writes the handoff and its own rendered copy of the interrupted step's instructions after the stop, places the interrupted step's packet in .baltor/step/ again, and records the digest of each file it placed. The step reads this file and never edits it; every evidence file records its sha256.

step_id.description: The identifier of the interrupted step. The handoff must name the same step.

handoff_sha256.description: The digest of the handoff file as the host wrote it.

interrupted_instructions_path.description: The host's own rendered copy of the interrupted step's instructions, for example .baltor/resume/interrupted-instructions.md, under a name no harness loads by itself.

interrupted_instructions_sha256.description: The digest of that copy as the host wrote it.

host_files.description: Every other file the host placed for this step, such as the interrupted step's input.json, with its digest.

host_placed_paths.description: Files or folders the host wrote into the workspace for this step. The check ignores them.

evidence_dir.description: Where the check writes one evidence file per run, for example .baltor/resume-output/evidence.

output_path.description: A path inside .baltor/ and outside .baltor/step/, the interrupted step's packet folder.
